title: The Trophy Needs Fine Print
logline: A tiny harvest-policy trophy keeps trying to crown a winner, but two separate pollock simulations make its own pedestal list the choices that still need testing.

cold_open.picture: Extreme close-up: a ridiculously grand brass trophy marked BETTER drops onto a tiny wheeled model-basin cart. Its weight tips the cart nose-down. A compact PLEASE SPECIFY flap snaps out beneath BETTER. We crane back to reveal a research basin, not a working fishery.
cold_open.promise: Better at what? The trophy will not acquire a winner through the film.

escalation.beat: At the dry dock research basin, repeated model seasons turn a brass ratchet beside a candidate-rule token. A second token labelled PREDEFINED RULE remains distinct. Reuse the QuestionToken silhouette. The trophy rides with the candidate. SIMULATION stays visible. No boat type stands in for an actual pollock fleet.

Dolly down to the waterline of the constant-recruitment basin. Physical tags identify the two rules and an underwater cutaway names SPAWNING BIOMASS. The candidate trophy proudly hoists HIGHER THAN COMPARISON. There is no countable quantitative school or scaled bar.

Crane to the deck above: a mechanical annual-season sign changes position with a comic overshoot, and LARGE CATCH SWINGS unfolds on the trophy base. The mechanism is explicitly a qualitative schematic, with no numeric years, plotted heights or invented catch levels. Its success banner is now too tall to fit under the basin gantry.

A complete scene transition parks the first basin behind its CONSTANT RECRUITMENT sign and opens a separately lit STOCK-LINKED RECRUITMENT basin. A separate copy of the candidate setup arrives; no live ocean or same trained rule is transformed. The shared trophy is a narrator prop comparing cases, not literal study apparatus.

The second basin reveals HIGHER CATCHES followed by LOWER SPAWNING BIOMASS, each explicitly relative to its comparison. A small label says SMOOTHER POLICY RESPONSE, with no animation that purports to show steadier annual catches. The trophy tries to rotate its favorable label forward; the lower-biomass label rotates with it and refuses to disappear.

earned_turn.strongest_fair_case: The simulation may reveal its own assumptions without establishing a good real management rule. It does not demonstrate real income, bycatch outcomes or operational readiness. Conventional alternatives may perform well too.
earned_turn.draw_at_full_strength: Pull out to show both basins are miniature models on a research platform. A full-size harbor beyond is physically enormous beside them. The candidate token and predefined-rule token stand side by side before three equally sized testing stations: CATCH PATTERN, BREEDING STOCK, OTHER MANAGEMENT GOALS. Nobody awards green ticks or declares either one victorious. An unfilled space labelled FURTHER TESTING remains ahead of both. The trophy tips forward to peek at the harbor, then settles back beside both tokens.
earned_turn.surviving_claim: The method has created candidates and exposed different outcomes worth comparing before real seasons. It has not picked a management winner.

button.last_line_intent: Ask which combination a harvest policy should have to demonstrate before calling it better.
button.last_image: The enormous BETTER topper tilts into a question mark orientation above the two candidate tokens. Its pedestal now reads FOR WHICH GOALS? The first shot's tipping cart finally sits level because the trophy has stopped pretending to name one winner. Do not imply that balance quantitatively measures equal ecological and economic outcomes.

sight_gags.gag: Overqualified trophy, underqualified cart: the grand award nearly faceplants before its PLEASE SPECIFY flap catches it.
sight_gags.meaning: The word better needs an outcome.

sight_gags.gag: The biomass success banner rises triumphantly, then its newly unfolded catch-swings footnote physically jams under the gantry.
sight_gags.meaning: One favorable result does not fit the whole management question.

sight_gags.gag: The trophy tries to show only HIGHER CATCHES; LOWER SPAWNING BIOMASS is bolted to the same rotating base and follows it into view.
sight_gags.meaning: The separate stock-linked result carries both findings.

sight_gags.gag: The tiny trophy peers toward a towering real harbor piling and retracts its victory pennant into a modest research flag.
sight_gags.meaning: A model result is still a model result.

retention_plan.throughline_object: One brass BETTER trophy, introduced at frame zero. Symbolic narrator prop only.

states.state: Top-heavy BETTER with PLEASE SPECIFY flap
Two separate scenario findings attached to opposite sides
FOR WHICH GOALS? pedestal lands the opening promise

loops.promise: What can this trophy actually crown?
loops.payoff: No winner yet; explicit goals and further comparison are the earned result.

loops.promise: Will the separate stock-linked experiment preserve the first apparent stock benefit?
loops.payoff: No: higher catches accompany lower spawning biomass relative to its comparison. Distinct from the trophy loop.

retention_plan.padding_test: The 68 to 94 second test adds the strongest limit on inference, draws two candidates on equal terms, and changes the award into a research object. Without it, a 90 second version would imply tradeoff discovery proves a usable rule. The 94 to 101 second recovery briefly credits policy exploration and connects it to season planning; do not repeat both case results here.

voice_and_runtime.instruction: Pitch only. No narration script or board yet. Leave breathing room around the 68 second and 94 second reveals.

real_stages: Dry dock model-basin workshop with gantry and floor depth
Constant-recruitment basin with deck and submerged cutaway
Separate stock-linked basin in a distinct bay
Research-platform exit facing a full-scale harbor
shot_scales: Extreme wide miniature research platform against harbor
camera_heights: Above gantry looking down through basin
Below waterline looking across spawning-biomass stage
staging.palette: Salt-dark teal water, warm brass trophy, coral-orange testing machinery; directional cool daylight, wet reflections and substantial foreground occlusion.

reuse: QuestionToken as rule tokens, with distinct copy
Character as working researcher who pushes cart and opens basin cover
library_and_growth.net_new: Characterized modular trophy with folding physical qualification tabs, expressive tilt and research-flag substitution. Pollock may be represented by clearly labelled species-neutral schematic fish silhouettes if no new correct pollock asset is available; never substitute salmon as pollock.
library_and_growth.freshness: No office, paper-sheet hero, pen, approval stamp or document carousel. Comedy comes from physical scale and a prematurely grand research trophy.

claim_guards: Unscaled conceptual devices only; no fabricated counts, data curves or biomass volumes.
Keep SIMULATION and case labels legible.
Smoother policy response is not annual catch stability.
Never describe the second experiment as a repair to the first.
No household income, bycatch success, deployed quota or real-world winner claim.
